applicable_to: Most IEEE conferences (e.g. ICRA, ICASSP, ICC, GLOBECOM, INDISCON) using the standard IEEEtran conference format.
notes: Class is auto-fetched by Tectonic at compile time; no bundled class file needed. Citation style: IEEEtran numeric (bibtex). main.tex is the full official IEEE template text (not a bare skeleton) so it demonstrates real structure: multi-author block, abstract, index terms, subsections, a table, and a full reference list -- verified to compile cleanly with zero Overfull/Underfull warnings. Contains 3 real matplotlib-generated figures (fig1/2/3.png -- a line chart, bar chart, and scatter plot) placed within the existing Figures and Tables discussion, demonstrating multi-figure placement with no overlay/blank-space/collapse issues. IEEE_Conference_Template.pdf is the original reference document for comparison only, not a template asset.
